subject: Momentum: 30-min webinar invite — schedule, tracking & snooze paths
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Momentum: 30-min webinar invite — schedule, tracking & snooze paths

Team —

This is the working thread for the 30-minute webinar (Momentum: Cost-Optimized LLM Serving) invite push. Goal = maximize developer attendance from mid-market / platform engineers while keeping cost per RSVP <= $12. Key asks: final copy, link mapping, reminder cadence, and snooze (reschedule) flow.

Quick summary / priorities:
- Launch invite (HTML + text) on Tue 5/11, stagger waves by timezone (APAC wave 5/11 22:00 UTC, EMEA 5/12 09:00 UTC, US 5/12 16:00 UTC).
- Tracking: single-click registration should map to HubSpot campaign HS-Deal-48291. Use tracking_matrix_v2.csv for UTM mapping.
- Capacity: Zoom seat limit = 800. We need threshold rules: when registrations hit 640 (80%), enable waitlist and seat-hold for strategic accounts.
- Snooze/reschedule: add a one-click snooze that moves registrants to the next timezone wave and triggers a single follow-up reminder 24 hours before the new wave. Details in snooze-paths-diagram.png.

Deliverables + owners (suggested):
- Marissa: finalize two subject line variants + primary HTML. A/B = “Momentum: 30-min deep-dive on inference economics” vs “Cut inference cost by 2x — 30-min demo + Q&A”.
- Mateo: build tracking matrix, UTM mapping, and set registration redirect / Zoom mapping.
- Karthik: confirm cadence for reminders, seat-hold policy text, and SDR handoff to convert high-fit registrants.

Attachments: tracking_matrix_v2.csv (UTMs), final_email_html_v3.html (working HTML), snooze-paths-diagram.png

Timeline: final copy + tracking sign-off by EOD Mon 5/10 so we can QA on Tue morning and deploy the first wave Tue midday.

Ping if anything blockers. Prefer short replies (approve / edit / need meeting).

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum: 30-min webinar invite — schedule, tracking & snooze paths

On Sun, May 9, 2027 at 9:12 AM Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> This is the working thread for the 30-minute webinar (...)

All good from copy perspective. Quick notes / proposals: 
- I’ll prepare the two subject line variants and limit body copy to three bullets + CTA to reduce scan time.
- Suggest we run a small subject line A/B (50/50) on the US wave only to keep tracking clean.
- Reminder cadence I propose: 48h pre (brief), 4h pre (calendar + CTA), 30m pre (short nudge). For snoozed registrants who choose a later wave, we only send the 24h pre + 30m pre to avoid fatigue.
- Seat-hold language: propose we reserve 5 seats per enterprise account that requests hold (explicit opt-in) and log holds in HubSpot deal note. If Acme AI requests more, we escalate to sales.

I’ll upload two subject lines + the trimmed HTML by EOD. Mateo — can you add UTM rows for subject_test and wave_id?

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Demand Gen, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum: 30-min webinar invite — schedule, tracking & snooze paths

Thanks everyone — quick operational checklist and owners (final):

1) Copy + assets (Marissa) — upload subject variants + final_email_html_v3.html to Drive and mark the chosen variant in the tracking matrix by 11:00 PDT Thu 5/13.
2) Tracking (Mateo) — ensure HubSpot campaign HS-Deal-48291 is receiving registration POSTs; add UTM rows: source=newsletter, medium=email, campaign=momentum_30m, wave_id=us_eu_apac, subject_test=a_b. Confirm Zoom integration maps registration -> attendee records.
3) Seat-hold (Mina) — hold 5 seats for Acme AI (Lily Chen) now; create a HubSpot note for the hold and tag SDR-Julia for follow-up on any expansion request >5 seats.
4) Reminders (Karthik) — implement Marissa’s cadence. For snooze flow: on click, write to a custom field "snooze_wave" and trigger the 24h reminder for the new wave only.
5) SDR Handoff (Marissa + Mateo) — add a segmentation rule: registrants with title containing "Engineer" + company size >500 employees flagged as high-fit; push to SDR queue and create a manual outreach template.

I’ve added HubSpot link and the Drive folder in related_links. I will create the waitlist when registrations hit 640 and notify this thread. Mina — can you confirm seat hold completed when done?

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Field Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
